correctness.rationale: PASS. The channel duplicates a consecutive pair ab as ab complement(b) complement(a), with no symbol fixed by the complement involution. Equating outputs at two starts reduces by cancellation to xz=zy; the length-one overlap and longer period-two word equations force the intervening original factor to alternate in complementary pairs, and conversely give equality. Consequently equivalence classes of start positions are maximal alternating runs, so B(w)=n-1-C(w), with C the count of length-three complementary alternating factors. The two suffix states (complementary pair or not) carry transitions [[q-1,1],[q-1,z]], yielding the asserted rational generating function with initial vector q(q-1),q. Indicator expectations 1/q² and adjacent joint 1/q³, while distance-two indicators are independent, give the stated variance. The n=2 boundary and all even q are handled; independent direct daughter-set and histogram enumeration confirmed small q,n without extrapolation.
